scope: Complete advanced factor-model teaching, four worked cases, eight original fully solved exercises, answered teach-back and retention; exact finite-state pricing, conditional approximate APT, nontraded-factor normalization, multifactor OLS, cross-sectional estimation and a lagged factor-construction cash ledger. reasoning_review: Same-horizon simple/excess returns, safe gross versus simple rates, and beginning-wealth exposures match the prerequisite contracts. A traded zero-cost factor is a payoff per reference notional, not a simple return on zero initial equity.

Exact spanning is proved both with the positive-SDF pricing identity and a complete trading argument. The full safe payoff and initial replica budget are retained; a clone quote compares the exact same dated payoff.

Projection orthogonality to factors is distinguished from SDF orthogonality. Alpha equals -Rf*Cov(m,residual); the Cauchy bound and its moment assumptions are explicit. The original positive-kernel example prices a factor-orthogonal residual with positive alpha and an actual hedged loss state.

Approximate pricing requires residual variance tending to zero and a uniform bound on SDF variation relative to its mean. Equal-weight residual variance is derived under bounded variances and zero pairwise residual covariances. It does not establish sure finite arbitrage or zero alpha for every individual asset.

The product-SDF family is strictly positive in each finite economy, prices the stated zero-cost claims, and has unbounded coefficient of variation across N. Its finite loss state and explicit N=4 loss probability prevent conflating asymptotic concentration with a sure statewise profit.

Nontraded-factor risk prices are covariance prices, not unconditional factor means. Centering, rescaling and the traded-factor special case are derived with units. Factor fit, economic mechanism and feasible replication remain different requirements.

OLS normal equations, full-rank uniqueness, factor covariance, R-squared conditions and omitted-variable identities are derived. A descriptive residual mean square is not called an alpha standard error; conditional covariance/inference assumptions are stated separately.

Cross-sectional estimation uses supplied prior-window betas, no free intercept under the maintained safe-rate restriction, and mean excess returns in the same evaluation window as the factor means. First-stage error, weighting, dependence, rank and model uncertainty are not silently removed.

The construction case uses information available at the trade, actual shares and prices, drift-aware traded volume, explicit reusable short proceeds, zero cash interest, fixed notional, cash-paid execution and borrow costs, and final liquidation. Account returns use changing equity; factor payoffs per fixed notional are not mislabeled as compound investor returns.

All eight exercise prompts were solved against their stated data. Seven have exact numerical reconstructions in the checker. The eighth has an explicit five-failure research rubric with acceptable repair/evidence criteria. Teach-back and all four retention questions have answers. Methods are taught before use.

The planned v12-c09 link matches the canonical title and is visibly labeled planned. Same-batch successor wording is neutral; manuscript routes and all five flat offline asset links follow existing conventions.

limitations: Author and later agent review are not external human certification or a guarantee of error-free material.
The chapter proves exact finite spanning and one sufficient conditional residual-pricing bound, not all infinite-market APT results.
All cases are synthetic. The package does not authenticate data, validate empirical premiums, establish causal compensation or investor skill, or forecast returns.

The lab is intentionally bounded to its guarded state law, eight-row sample and four-asset/four-period ranking contract. It is not a general SDF calibration, inference, margin or trading engine; extreme floating-point magnitudes and arbitrary malformed schemas are outside the numerical contract.
Observed-date cash solvency and no intraperiod margin calls are stipulated; actual financing availability, market impact and capacity require additional evidence.

Coordinator independent review, prerequisite acceptance, shared integration, whole-library verification and publication remain separate. Visual, keyboard, mobile and print QA are not claimed by this focused checker.
